## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it belongs in a local-first document application.

## Validation

- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make typecheck`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make evaluate`
- [ ] UI behavior checked when applicable

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No private documents, secrets, machine-specific paths, telemetry, or remote assets added
- [ ] File, workspace, and deletion boundaries remain enforced
- [ ] Documentation and migrations updated where required
